decisions.statement: ok. when i was talking about literate programming i meant this: today the most valuable nuggets of information are these sentences and desisions that human (me) make. and the resulting code and artifacts are circumstantial. so you need to think how can we tie them together. think diffs. each line has a git history (init git and do several commits btw based on when and after what we've built here). each diff has a human intent behind it and LLM agent reasoning of WHY. that is what i want to see. that is what is important. attributing desicions to artifacts

rationale.summary: Preserve exact human statements as primary, immutable records. Keep explicit agent rationale and its public source separate from those words. Git trailers, immutable commit manifests, diffs and rename-aware line blame link decisions to artifacts; unknown and uncommitted lines remain unattributed. Review freezes the Git tree and checkpoints only those bytes, preserving later working edits and unrelated staged files. A local commit hook requires an intent, scope and rationale. Earlier milestones are explicitly reconstructed from recorded patches and captured snapshots.

rationale.summary: Wheel events over the conversation must use the same anchored smooth camera zoom as the rest of the canvas. A draggable scrollbar supplies independent conversation scrolling: a shared thumb calculation keeps drawing and hit testing aligned, pointer capture permits dragging outside the card, and a proportional grab offset remains valid while zooming. Scrollbar dragging never pans the camera or moves the card. Reading older messages stops automatic following; reaching the bottom restores it.

Apply that typography only to popups, retaining source text, highlighting ranges, meaningful code whitespace, and LaTeX layout. The conversation header shows only its title, reclaims the removed status row, and drops the persistent footer hint.

decisions.statement: why clicking on a file name in cmake does nothing? is there like a lsp for cmake too?

rationale.summary: CMake filenames are document links, while the viewer previously asked only clangd for C++ symbol definitions. Reuse the asynchronous LSP transport for neocmakelsp and route CMake documents to it. Cache versioned document links and open their actual server-provided targets on click; retain definition requests for symbols. Share globally unique request IDs across servers, respect advertised capabilities, and refresh links and diagnostics on source changes. Pin and verify the upstream language-server release for reproducible installation. The server omits quoted paths containing spaces, so literal existing project paths have a narrow file-navigation fallback without attempting CMake variable evaluation.

decisions.statement: the text cursor creates expectation that text can be selected. can we add ability to select text?

rationale.summary: A text cursor promises selectable text. Use the same Pango UTF-8 caret and range geometry as rendering for drag selection in source cards, popups, messages, decision documents and editors. Selection capture keeps dragging separate from panning, supports Shift extension and clipboard shortcuts, and exposes PRIMARY selection on X11. Text links activate on click release so dragging over them can select. Keep rendering GPU-based, cull offscreen highlights, and reject stale document snapshots after live edits; copied equations retain their LaTeX expression.

decisions.statement: now that we have lsp for cmake, it reports some untydiness there. can we add like a formatter or something to automatically maintain it error and warning free?

rationale.summary: Use cmake-format and cmake-lint with a shared 80-column, four-space policy. Configure/build and the format target repair layout automatically; remaining lint findings stop the build and the same checks run in the quality gate and CI. Fix actual loop-variable naming and long argument lists rather than suppressing warnings. Watch policy and tooling changes so the live viewer rebuilds when the policy changes. Verify both lint rejection and formatting repair, and confirm the real CMake language server reports an empty diagnostic list.

decisions.statement: now, i want to be able to spawn the agent window wherever i want. and i wnat it understand the context of where i'm at the moment.

rationale.summary: Agent cards belong at the point of work. Right-click or Ctrl+Shift+A creates a new independent conversation at the captured world position without moving the camera; existing cards retain their threads, drafts and positions. Capture the pointed file, line, nested LSP symbol, nearby source and selected text, or visible files on blank canvas. Display this attachment locally and send it separately through the local agent protocol as project context, preserving the exact human request and its provenance. Refresh source excerpts before each send. Persist every card and context through viewer reload, route input and approvals per conversation, and wait for requests in any card before reloading. Serialize live and validation builds with a shared workspace lock so simultaneous agent edits and quality checks cannot corrupt build artifacts. Verify native placement and restoration on a separate X display, protocol isolation with a fake peer, and lock contention with real build fixtures.

Keyboard and mouse navigation reuse canvas location jumps so hidden blocks are revealed and Unicode positions remain correct. Keep query editing, selection and clipboard routing separate from agent drafts, refresh results on disk changes, preserve search state across viewer reload, and release cached result GPU meshes when replacing matches. decisions.statement: see image in my clipboard. why is there an erorr? i cant seem to send anything into popup agent

rationale.summary: The clipboard screenshot exposed a premature thread history read before the first accepted user message. A real isolated send probe also revealed that the context attachment name contained spaces and uppercase letters rejected by the local server. Use a valid lowercase identifier, send the first turn directly after thread creation, and load history only on resume. Keep history failures independent from send acknowledgements so they cannot clear pending sends or enable duplicate submissions. Mark a new thread persistent only after an accepted turn and recover previously unsent cards when their ephemeral thread has no saved rollout, preserving the composer draft without replaying it. Validate the exact request ordering, retry and reload state with regressions, and add an explicit opt-in live contextual-send test that verifies the actual agent reply and archives its isolated test conversation. Run the native live-canvas mouse-capture test on an isolated X display so validation does not contend with the user desktop.
